results.title: Lust
results.overview: Professor Michael Meloun arrives in Belgrade as a visiting lecturer. He suffers a panic attack, and doctors find out his agoraphobia has worsened. He must stay indoors. Maria, whom he meets at the hospital, stays to care for him.

results.title: Kraken. The Black Book of Hours
results.original_title: Kraken: El libro negro de las horas
results.overview: Unai López de Ayala must immerse himself in the world of art collecting and forgery in order to find the legendary Black Book of Hours and save his mother, whom he had long believed to be dead

results.title: Dandelion's Odyssey
results.overview: Two dandelion balls are the only survivors of a series of nuclear explosions that are destroying the Earth. At the end of their odyssey, they will find a new soil for the survival of their species.

results.title: Mimic
results.overview: The ancient tradition of Mimicry is a dying art. When Maggie, the last remaining Mimic in England has her world turned upside-down by a patient, she begins to find the cracks in her reality start to widen. What would you do if you could have one last conversation with someone you've lost?

results.title: My Son’s Sugar Mama
results.overview: A protective mother discovers a wealthy, older woman is showering her young son with gifts and money. As she sets out to expose her, she discovers the woman's obsession with her son is far more dangerous than she ever could have imagined.

results.title: No Paradise If You Are Killed by a Woman
results.overview: A female Kurdish-Norwegian sniper returns to the battlefield she once escaped, driven by vengeance and by the desperate hope of rescuing her younger sister, still imprisoned by ISIS in Mosul.

results.title: Crazy Kalyanam
results.overview: The story focuses on a village girl, played by Anupama Parameswaran, who faces struggles regarding her inability to get married, which drives the comedic and family-oriented plot.

results.title: The Story of Everything
results.overview: The Story of Everything is a cinematic exploration of the cosmos that reveals the hidden hand behind our universe. From the precise laws that govern the stars to the intricate patterns found in every living cell, the film traces evidence of intentional design throughout nature. Whether examining distant star-forming clouds or the spiral structure of DNA, we discover a consistent signature woven into the fabric of existence.

results.title: The Assassin(s)
results.overview: In 1974, a shooting shocks South Korea. Detective Cheol-gu, who witnesses the attack, Jae-hwan, the city desk editor whose coverage is suppressed, and Young-il, a rookie reporter, begin to dig beneath the cover-up. As their pursuit of the truth deepens, they come to confront forces meant to remain unseen.

results.title: The Dresden Sun
results.overview: A brilliant, principled mercenary with a traumatic past works with an insider to steal a valued asset from Peredor Corporation called “the sphere”. The C & Earth corporation, vying for global dominance, seeks to find a solution to an otherworldly technology via a scientist’s project. Meanwhile, a financial analyst, who despises his job at the powerful investment firm Mutual One, finds himself caught between deadly corporate rivals, financial fraud, and technological espionage, and is ultimately forced to run from a psychopathic military contractor.

results.title: Ghost Song
results.overview: Farasha and Faris are 20 when they meet at a graduation party – one glance that changes everything. But Farasha dies that very same night. Refusing to be separated from him, she discovers a way to cross the boundary between worlds: for 40 nights, and 40 nights only, she can meet Faris in his dreams. And so their love continues to grow, until the very last night.

results.title: Sleeping Beauty Next Door
results.overview: Sydney's rare condition makes her collapse whenever emotions run high-especially in love. When her charming new neighbor Taylor steals her heart, she must fight to stay awake long enough to turn her dream romance into reality.

results.title: MANJAR
results.overview: A youthful Marathi family entertainer about friendship, love, family relationships and the unpredictable situations of everyday life, seen through the amusing perspective of an observant cat.

results.title: The Last Scene
results.overview: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with a man, Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.

results.title: Make Zhonghe Great Again
results.overview: After encountering a standout colleague from a company event, Liu Ben, a section chief at Zhonghe Group's branch, embarks on a quirky professional journey with him, uncovering their true self-worth through chaotic workplace challenges.

results.title: Blackout
results.overview: After a sudden power outage, people awaken to a world cast in eternal night. Each trapped in their own isolated version of reality. Soon they are confronted by mysterious figures known as The Ushers, Who claim they can lead them to a place where a final irreversible choice must be made.

results.title: Zumbido
results.overview: "On a film set, a sound recordist detects a strange noise interfering with the filming. Meanwhile, the self-centered director disregards her, focusing only on giving flawed guidance to the actor.

results.title: Beck 54 - In the shadows
results.overview: A violent gang in one of Stockholm's suburbs is suspected of another fatal shooting and the Stockholm police are conducting a cross-border operation to prosecute the leader of the gang.

results.title: Cek Khodam
results.overview: Nowadays, people are more afraid of empty wallets, late payments, and the end of the month than ghosts. Ghosts are even used as entertainment through the content Cek Khodam (Hodgkin's Check) created by three friends, Sakti, Wira, and Bima. Unbeknownst to them, their actions have drastically reduced the Human Fear Score (AKM). To restore the dignity of the supernatural world and raise the human fear score, the Commander of the Khodam is tasked with descending directly into the human world. However, the mission does not go according to plan. The harder the khodam try to scare humans, the more chaos they create.
